syllabus.details: Subjects include irrigation engineering, water resource management, surveying and advanced surveying, soil mechanics, concrete technology, estimation/costing/valuation, hydrology and advanced hydrology, hydraulics, engineering mechanics, structural mechanics, RCC design, and construction materials, advanced construction technology and quality control. how_to_apply: Visit ojas.gujarat.gov.in and complete OTR (One Time Registration) if not already registered.
Under Online Application → Apply, select GSSSB and Advertisement No. 461/202627 for Work Assistant, Class 3.
Choose Apply Now, enter the OTR registration number and date of birth, and proceed with Apply with OTR.
Review prefilled personal details, enter SSC information, bank account and IFSC details for the potential fee refund, and upload the bank passbook image as required.
Complete educational details and the declaration. Save the form and record the application number.
Upload the prescribed photograph and signature. Follow the notification's file-format, dimension, date and size instructions.
Review the application carefully and use Confirm Application. The notification states changes are not possible after confirmation.
Pay the prescribed fee online by the separate fee deadline, download the payment receipt and retain the confirmed application.

Before you confirm: Check your name, date of birth, category, diploma qualification and bank information against the original documents. The advertisement warns that discrepancies may result in cancellation.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Work Assistant Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: GSSSB has advertised 1,663 posts. Category-wise counts are shown below; women, PwD and ex-servicemen figures are reservations within the overall vacancies and should not be added to the total. Of these posts, the notification identifies category-wise reservations for women (232 unreserved, 53 EWS, 146 SEBC, 38 SC, 80 ST), as well as 113 PwD and 166 ex-servicemen reserved vacancies. Refer to the official notification for disability-category suitability and full reservation conditions.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must have a Diploma in Civil Engineering issued by an eligible institution, or one of the explicitly recognized equivalent diploma qualifications. They must have basic knowledge of computer applications and adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both. Important: A Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering does not meet the stated eligibility requirement. The notification specifically excludes Civil Engineering degree holders. Recognized equivalent diploma qualifications include the following as listed by the department : Diploma in Civil (Construction) Diploma in Civil (Public Health and Environment) Engineering Diploma in Civil Engineering (Environment and Pollution Control) Diploma in Civil Engineering (Environmental and Pollution Control) Diploma in Construction Technology Diploma in Civil Engineering (Environmental Engineering) Diploma in Civil Engineering (Public Health Engineering) Diploma in Civil Engineering (Rural Engineering) Diploma in Civil Engineering Environment and Pollution Control Diploma in Civil Environmental Engineering Diploma in Civil Engineering (Construction Technology) Diploma in Construction Engineering Diploma in Civil Technology Diploma in Civil and Environmental Engineering Diploma in Civil and Rural Engineering Diploma in Civil Draftsman Diploma in Civil Engineering Diploma in Civil Engineering and Planning Diploma in Civil Engineering (Building Service Engineering) Diploma in Construction Technology and Management Diploma in Quantity Surveying and Construction Management Diploma in Survey Engineering Diploma in Transportation Engineering Computer certificate note: The notification permits candidates without the required basic computer knowledge certificate to apply, but they must submit the necessary proof before appointment. Eligibility is assessed with reference to 29 October 2026 . Minimum age is 18 years . Reservation benefits are subject to the applicable domicile, certificate and category requirements explained in the notification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for GSSSB Work Assistant 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification advertises 1,663 Work Assistant, Class 3 vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Online applications close on 29 October 2026 at 11:59 PM. The fee-payment deadline is 1 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. Can a B.E. or B.Tech Civil Engineering graduate apply?
faq.answer: The notification explicitly states that holders of a Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering are not eligible. Candidates should review the exact notified qualification requirements before submitting an application.

faq.question: Q4. What is the GSSSB Work Assistant salary?
faq.answer: The initial fixed monthly remuneration is ₹26,000 for the first five years, with eligibility for Level 4 (₹25,500–₹81,100) afterwards, subject to conditions.

faq.question: Q5. Will the examination fee be refunded?
faq.answer: Yes, examination attendees are eligible for a refund as specified in the notification; absentees and candidates whose applications are rejected are not eligible.

faq.question: Q6. What is the exam pattern?
faq.answer: The single-stage MCQ examination has 210 questions for 210 marks over three hours, divided into Part A (90 marks) and Part B (120 marks), with one-fourth negative marking.

faq.question: Q7. Is there negative marking in the GSSSB Work Assistant examination?
faq.answer: Yes, 1/4th (0.25) marks will be deducted for every incorrect answer.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I apply for the GSSSB Work Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official OJAS website at https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in.
